key.name: toggle-shortcut
key.summary: Keys that open and close the launcher

key.name: shortcut-asked
key.summary: Whether the question about Super+Space was asked
key.description: Asked once, on the first enable, when Super+Space also switches input sources.

key.name: input-source-taken
key.summary: Keys taken from the input source switch
key.description: What was removed from org.gnome.desktop.wm.keybindings switch-input-source, so it can be given back.

key.name: compact
key.description: auto: on a screen narrower than 1400 logical pixels; always; never.

key.name: see-through
key.description: Lets the windows show through the panel's outer surface, as in Halo. No blur.

key.name: animations
key.description: The pill scaling in, the panel growing. Also follows GNOME's own animation setting.

key.name: providers
key.summary: Search providers of other apps that are asked
key.description: Desktop ids. Each one is a D-Bus round trip into another app, so none is on by default.

key.name: web-template
key.summary: Address of a custom search engine, with %s for the query

key.name: learn
key.description: Counts what is opened for what was typed, in ~/.local/share/material-search/usage.json.

key.name: forget-requested
key.summary: Set to the time to forget all use counts
